## What's Changed
* fix(release): make the macOS Tauri lane produce and publish a .dmg by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/181
* fix(upload): never report 100% complete for an upload that did not publish by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/182
* fix(instagram): reconcile a post-publish failure instead of losing the reel by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/183
* deps(ci): bump actions/setup-node from 4 to 7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/184
* deps(ci): bump astral-sh/setup-uv from 5 to 7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/185
* fix(tiktok): add PKCE (S256) to the OAuth authorize and token exchange by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/172
* fix(readiness): report an unprobed session as unknown, not invalid by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/174
* fix(release): make media binary fetch resilient to partial downloads by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/176
* test(release): prove a stranger can install and run a published artifact by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/180
* chore(security): extend public-safety scan to PII, tokens and built artifacts by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/187
* feat(release): add Windows and Linux Tauri build lanes by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/175
* feat(ui): first-run flow end to end in the Tauri/Svelte shell by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/190
* fix(release): make the updater manifest actually publish by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/177
* docs(site): add the YouTube API Services disclosures the API audit requires by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/192
* docs(site): stop advertising TikTok publishing by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/195
* feat(content): one typed publish contract {content_type, media[], text, overrides} (C1a) by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/203
* fix(security): require auth for every mutating dashboard route by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/204
* fix(status): one fact, one answer across CLI/MCP/HTTP status surfaces by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/205
* feat(analytics): per-post/per-platform outcomes, recorded vs live labelled (D5) by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/212
* fix(tests): present API token to /api/connect in agreement harness by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/213
* fix(mcp): schedule cancel, targeted retry, and honest xpst_delete scope by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/198
* feat(ui): composer media preview + native picker and drag-drop by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/211
* refactor(state,analytics): one state owner, one AnalyticsCollector by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/209
* feat(auth): honest token state — background refresh + truthful badges by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/210
* feat(bundle): stop shipping ffmpeg (-87MB of 192MB) — system ffmpeg or fetch once on first use by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/206
* fix(media): stop the image trap — modality-aware media spec, and a media listing that never offers what it hard-rejects by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/202
* docs(readme): generate the surface counts so they cannot drift by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/208
* feat(release): publish updater artifacts and a hosted update manifest by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/179
* fix(carousel): a photo carousel is a carousel — or a named refusal, never a stitch-to-video by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/223
* feat(content): real text posts for X and Threads — one limit, no truncation by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/226
* fix(robustness): harden first-run and failure outcomes; honour XPST_CONFIG_DIR by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/188
* chore(build): measure and budget the engine bundle (F3) by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/197
* docs: purge remaining TikTok-publishing claims from repo docs + regression guard by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/214
* fix(analytics): live dashboard refresh actually collects (posted_to id vs post_id) by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/215
* deps(pip): update instagrapi requirement from <3.0.0,>=2.0.0 to >=2.0.0,<4.0.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/217
* fix(threads): make the Threads URL-fetch limitation first-class so no surface promises a local file (C7) by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/219
* fix(cli): xpst post exits non-zero when nothing was published by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/222
* fix(status): one probe verdict for health, doctor and auth status by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/228
* docs(readme): remove leftover git-conflict markers from the #208 claims fixup by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/229
* perf(boot): measure cold boot on the real bundle and gate it in CI by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/194
* fix(shell): close the unclosed delimiter breaking every shell build, and gate it in CI by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/230
* fix(post/delete): post --visibility, delete by platform id or URL (recover #169) by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/232
* fix(ci): boot-budget lane asserts a bundled ffmpeg the design removed by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/236
* feat(post): single-image posts to Instagram (feed) and X by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/218
* deps: refresh the lockfile past the current advisory set by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/237
* fix(home): one readiness verdict and one labelled row per platform role by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/233
* feat(facebook): Page-scoped Facebook destination — connect, Page discovery, agent surface by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/221
* deps(ci): bump actions/setup-python from 5 to 7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/216
* chore(analytics): remove the dead YouTube Analytics API v2 path by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/201
* docs(agents): rewrite AGENTS.md for the engine+Tauri architecture by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/193
* fix(post): refuse a zero-destination post with one canonical error by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/200
* fix(release): pin and checksum every media binary the Tauri lane bundles by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/196
* security: audit + fix credential/log/auth/SSRF/path surfaces, add supply-chain CI by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/189
* test(health-cache): give the non-blocking bounds runner headroom by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/240
* fix(encode-cache): only serve a cached encode whose codec matches the pipeline's by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/241
* fix(facebook): give Facebook Page a media spec so preflight stops lying by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/239
* fix(about): the UI stops inventing its version — the engine reports the real one by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/242
* fix(branding): regenerate the app icon set from assets/icon.png by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/243
* fix(ui): never show a raw startup error — the launch race is a starting state by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/234
* fix(cli): run / backfill / schedule run exit non-zero when every destination failed by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/238
* fix(truth): a download source is not a posting destination by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/235
* feat(content): per-destination copy — overrides reach every uploader and every surface by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/224
* feat(media): carry a remote media URL to the destination that fetches it by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/225
* feat(compose): durable drafts that survive navigation, and stale-plan invalidation by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/199
* feat(connect): in-app Sign in control - OAuth state machine + deep-link callback (B1) by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/207
* feat(content): one content_type contract on CLI/MCP/HTTP — and stop declaring what we cannot post by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/220
* refactor(desktop): delete the legacy PySide6/QML lane so the repo builds one desktop app by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/231
* UI 1.2: theme control, grouped nav, and working actions on dead-end pages by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/244
* feat: delete/unpublish posts from the Library UI (engine delete contract over HTTP) by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/245
* chore(release): bump the release version to 1.2.0 by @TysAIs in https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/pull/246


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/TysAIs/xPST/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0
